PCAP iterator and packet read/write helpers for Ethernet frames and headers.

# Purpose
This header defines the public interface for reading and writing `pcap` packet capture data. It declares the opaque `fd_pcap_iter_t` iterator type, constants for iterator modes and link-layer types, and functions to open a capture stream, read packets, and split packet data into header and payload buffers. It also provides functions to write `pcap` file headers and packet records to either a standard stream or a buffered output stream, with support for timestamp handling and Ethernet frame formatting. The file is used by the network utility layer to convert between raw packet data and the `pcap` file format in a controlled and reusable way.
